purpose: Define the initial invariant family required for indexed projectional equivalence claims.

I_closure.pass_condition: A and B both sustain non-collapsing recursive continuation.
I_closure.failure_condition: One side collapses, terminates, or cannot preserve recursive return.

I_admissibility.pass_condition: A and B both require filtered continuation rather than automatic realization.
I_admissibility.failure_condition: One side permits unconstrained realization or lacks a selection filter.

I_residue.pass_condition: A and B both carry prior-state influence into later admissible states.
I_residue.failure_condition: One side is memoryless under transition.

I_orientation.pass_condition: A and B both require a reference relation that orders transition direction.
I_orientation.failure_condition: One side permits unordered transition without orientation reference.

I_selection.pass_condition: A and B both distinguish candidate states from realized states.
I_selection.failure_condition: One side has no candidate-realization distinction.

governance_rules.rule: No invariant may be used in ⇔x[I_k] unless it appears in the invariant registry.
Each invariant must include definition, pass condition, and failure condition.
A projectional equivalence claim fails if its indexed invariant fails.
Multiple invariant claims must be listed independently rather than collapsed into a general equivalence claim.

valid_multi_invariant_form.truth_condition: All listed invariants must pass independently.
